question: Who among the following won the Gold medal at Paralympics in the Women's 10m air rifle standing SH1 Shooting category?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Avani Lekhara**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Avani Lekhara** won the gold medal in the **Women's 10m air rifle standing SH1 event at the 2024 Paris Paralympics. **
 
• Avani Lekhara** is an Indian para shooter who won her second consecutive gold medal in the women's 10m air rifle event. **
 
• She** scored 249.7 points, **breaking her own previous record of 249.6 set in 2021. 
 
• Lekhara is wheelchair bound after a vehicle accident left her paralyzed below the waist when she was 11 years old.
